question: with a shipped-scale oracle finally in hand, does the shipped V4.1 ROM WAFER deployment execute?

the_refusal.failure: prefill failed: view 1097: loop 1076 is not active

localised_to.prior_art_in_this_tree: EMBED_LOOKUP has a recorded history of addressing faults here: "legacy unkeyed bases ignore the placement table -- EMBED_LOOKUP and GATHER addressed by launch counter, so the token id was validated and never used". That is a different fault from this one, but it is the same operator and the same part of the lowering.
localised_to.reading: the EMBED_LOOKUP at descriptor 1100 writes a rank-2 view whose only dynamic term is loop 1076, a SINGLE-ITERATION loop whose body spans program positions 239 to 495.  For the view to resolve, the operator must be issued inside that body.  It is not, so the resolver refuses.  Exactly one descriptor in the deployment references view 1097, so there is no ambiguity about which operator owns the fault.

the_refusal.what_it_means: view 1097 carries a dynamic term of kind LOOP_INDUCTION naming loop 1076, and loop 1076 is not in the active loop set when the view is resolved. The view is used outside the loop that indexes it -- a lowering fault in the deployment, caught by the resolver rather than producing a wrong address.
